sites.name: Lion City (Shicheng), Qiandao Lake
sites.era: Han to Ming and Qing towns flooded in 1959
sites.what: The submerged county towns of Shicheng and Hecheng under Qiandao Lake, Chun'an county; Hangzhou's CPPCC reports joint judicial and administrative protection of the underwater heritage.

access.permits: Diving needs approval from the cultural heritage authorities; ordinary recreational diving is not offered

underwater.diving: Not open to recreational divers; any diving needs cultural heritage authority approval
underwater.law: Regulations on the Protection and Administration of Underwater Cultural Relics (2022 revision)
underwater.penalties: Legal liability for endangering underwater relics (regulations)
